description: On the green tablecloth there’s a small metal wire rack with a shallow tray inside it, and a loose pile of colorful plastic utensils (spoons, forks, and knives) in front. The right hand reaches in from the right, scoops the scattered utensils together into a bundled right-hand object, lifts them up and forward toward the rack, then lowers and releases them into the tray so they lie inside the rack.
